query:
-- Buscar Mateus, Rehbein, Teteu na tabela users
SELECT id, openId, name, email, lastSignedIn
FROM users
WHERE name LIKE '%Mateus%' OR name LIKE '%Rehbein%' OR name LIKE '%Teteu%' OR email LIKE '%teteu%' OR email LIKE '%rehbein%'
ORDER BY lastSignedIn DESC;
